//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the RICH code block — the <pre class="pa-code …"> form. NEUTRAL scenarios + the GOLDEN markup core blesses. This is the block-level sibling of the inline code.json (which covers the bare inline <code>). SCOPE: the <pre class="pa-code"> element + its modifiers (language accent / --compact / --numbered). The HEADERED pa-code-block form (pa-code-block__header/__title/__body + the 📋 Copy button) is emitted by a DIFFERENT component in each wrapper than the one the shared `code-block` dumper key drives (keen code_block/1 only grows the header when filename/copy_text is set; svelte's bare CodeBlock.svelte — wired to this key — has no header at all, its header form lives in the separate CodeBlockWithHeader.svelte). The dumper REGISTRY is not touchable, so the headered form + the syntax-token spans (pa-code-keyword/string/… authored inside the slot by a highlighter) are deferred — see deferred + goldenConventions. See ../README.md and code.json for the model.

propsVocabulary.language: javascript|json|html|css|bash|sql|python — language accent (coloured left border); core ships accents for these seven only
propsVocabulary.numbered: boolean — empty line-number gutter on the inline-start side (pa-code--numbered)
propsVocabulary.content: code text (slot / inner_block) — rendered verbatim inside <pre>
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the <pre>

goldenConventions:
Goldens encode the core snippet shape (snippets/code.html): a bare 
CODE
. The 
 carries NO added attribute conventions. Content is a plain text token so the diff checks structural nesting + class contract, not rich highlighting. The headered pa-code-block form (pa-code-block__header > __title + Copy button; pa-code-block__body > pre) is a separate component per wrapper (see //), driven by filename/copy state, with a JS clipboard delegator for the copy button + its copied state — all JS/state-runtime and out of the shared-key render scope, so pa-code-block__* is deferred. Syntax-token spans (pa-code-keyword/string/number/comment/function/property) are authored inside the slot by a highlighter, not produced by the wrapper — they are not pa-code__* elements (own blocks) so the axis-1 element check does not expect them. Class-token order + whitespace are normalized away; goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. `produces` with {value}; capability.mjs expands + cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper's map + the scenario set. `produces: null` = structural/native.

language.note: core ships a coloured left-border accent for exactly these seven

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: No pa-code--* / pa-code-block--* modifier is JS-applied; this bucket is empty (all modifiers are feature-driven). Kept for the axis-1 reverse-check contract shape.

deferred.//: pa-code-block__* header/body elements emitted by the HEADERED code-block form — a different component than the one the shared `code-block` dumper key drives in each wrapper (keen code_block/1 with filename/copy_text; svelte CodeBlockWithHeader.svelte). The dumper REGISTRY is not editable in this slice, so the headered form can't be rendered under this key — deferred as acknowledged out-of-scope (prose, unverified).
deferred.pa-code-block__header: header row (title + copy actions) — headered form only
deferred.pa-code-block__title: filename / description in the header — headered form only
deferred.pa-code-block__body: body wrapper that strips the inner <pre> border/radius — headered form only

scenarios.note: content deliberately avoids quotes/apostrophes/angle-brackets/ampersands: HEEx and Svelte SSR HTML-escape those differently (' → ' in HEEx, " → ", < → < in both but inconsistently). The normalizer compares text verbatim, so neutral scenarios steer clear of them — a framework text-escaping divergence, not a markup contract difference (same convention as tooltip.json's `help` scenario).
